claims.explanation: For P(x)=(x-a)(x-b)(x-c), P(-1)=(-1-a)(-1-b)(-1-c)=-(a+1)(b+1)(c+1)=-1, and similarly P(-2)=-2, P(-3)=-3. The signs are reversed; the given products are 1,2,3, not the P-values.
Even using the preceding P-values, P(-1)-(-1)=1+1=2, not 0; likewise 2+2=4 and 3+3=6. Thus Q(-1), Q(-2), Q(-3) are not zero and -1,-2,-3 are not roots of Q.
P(-4)=(-4-a)(-4-b)(-4-c)=-(a+4)(b+4)(c+4), so the requested product is -P(-4). Since the computed P(-4) is -10, the correct requested value is 10, not -10.
